test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option from the given alternatives.

In to
day's digital age, convenience often comes at the cost of privacy. Every time a user browses a website, clicks a link, or uses an app, their data is collected sometimes without their knowledge. Companies use this information to target ads, predict behavior, or even sell insights to third parties. While this can lead to better services, it also raises ethical concerns. Who controls this data? How is it stored, and can users truly opt out? Many people accept terms and conditions without reading them, unknowingly giving permission for data tracking. Some countries have passed laws to protect user data, but implementation remains weak, As surveillance tools grow smarter, the line between public and private becomes blurred. Individuals must now learn to balance the benefits of technology with the right to privacy-a task that requires awareness, regulation, and responsible digital behavior.

What is one positive use of user data mentioned in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights both the risks and benefits of data collection in the digital age.
 
• One positive use mentioned is that companies can utilize user data to provide **better services**.
 
• This means data-driven personalization helps improve user experience and service quality.
 
• Other options like reducing screen time, blocking global access, or avoiding social media are **not stated** in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2 – Improving service experiences**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reducing screen time** – not mentioned as a benefit of user data in the passage.
 
• **Blocking global access** – irrelevant to the context of data collection.
 
• **Avoiding social media** – also not stated in the passage as a benefit.
